description:
Nubrik is a visual page builder for Umbraco, built for agencies and in-house teams who need full brand control without compromise.

			Build pages visually using ready-made blocks, brand-controlled themes, and a live preview experience — all while writing content back natively to Umbraco. No lock-in. No proprietary data formats. Just Umbraco, done faster.

			Key features:
			- Fully decoupled builder that sits alongside Umbraco and keeps all content in native structures
			- Brand-first editing with custom colors, fonts, and assets baked in
			- Ready-made building blocks to launch pages and campaign sites quickly
			- Live preview while building — see exactly what your audience will see
			- Save and reuse page layouts across briefs and projects
			- Animation and visual behaviour per page element

			Nubrik is developed by Phases, powered by an in-house team of Umbraco MVPs, Masters, and experienced professionals with a strong track record in delivering projects.

			Requirements: Umbraco 17+, .NET 10, SQL Server

			A valid license key is required for production use.
			Add your key to appsettings or via environment variable: Nubrik__Licensing__Key

			For installation instructions, licensing, and support:
			https://support.nubrik.app/hc/nubrik/articles/1780907445-installing-nubrik
title: Nubrik – Visual Builder for Umbraco
